==Mythos Source==
The Elder Things are first mentioned in H.P. Lovecraft's short story ''The Dreams in the Witch-House'' (1933) and they first appear in Lovecraft's novella ''At the Mountains of Madness'' (1936).  Additional references are found in Lovecraft's short story ''The Shadow Out of Time'' (1936).

== Clarification ==
When you fail an [[Evade check]], you must discard 1 of your [[Weapons]] or [[Spells]] as well.
